scope: Fixed protocol before new formal Dev curves. This file does not authorize bypassing pending GPU engineering, inference identity, provenance or complete evaluation gates. Formal six-arm controller and all-Dev/all-Test pipeline must be ready before formal fitting.

architecture.known_primitives: Center-surround contrast, learned convolutional cue pyramid, confidence gating, Farneback warping and a positive-variance recursive filter are established primitives, not themselves novelty claims.
architecture.quality: Learn actual cue features from full YOLOX box/object/class loss, with current-frame quality gating and reliable RGB preservation.
architecture.temporal: The quality architecture plus current-to-previous RGB flow and confidence-weighted native latent history. Positive variances are internal confidence parameters, not calibrated thermal sensor noise.

fit.optimizer: AdamW, only native fusion parameters; frozen original RGB encoder/head in evaluation mode.
fit.precision: Frozen GPU RGB encoder FP16; auxiliary module, frozen train head and loss FP32. CPU engineering uses FP32 encoder. No CPU/GPU numerical parity claim.
fit.determinism: Seed0, deterministic algorithms/CuDNN, CuBLAS4096:8, TF32 disabled; past memory and optical flow detached before every frame. Actual GPU engineering must pass before fitting.

Train_delivery.address_schedule: SeedSequence([0, one-based epoch]) shuffles sorted video order; frames remain chronological within each video. Short tails retained. No cross-video clips.
Train_delivery.weighting: Natural video duration, including the long PF-001 video, not balanced per-video sampling. Standard foreground-normalized YOLOX loss per clip, including short tails.
Train_delivery.temporal_state: Continues across adjacent clips and optimizer updates within each video; resets between videos/epochs and on unavailable cue. Stop gradient through every past state, no BPTT. Past training states may have been computed before a parameter update.
Train_delivery.unavailable: Flat scalar cue is unavailable. All-unavailable clips deliver frames but skip AdamW instead of fabricating a gradient update. Report delivered clips and actual updates separately.
Train_delivery.proof: Actual delivered per-epoch addresses/digests and unique frame coverage; original GT/calibration hashes. No Dev/Test labels are accessible to the fit.

budget_and_Dev.Dev: Both complete Dev videos/4834 frames at every snapshot for all six matched fits, plus IR unavailable and actual IR-image roll for each IR mode. Source canonical RGB and fresh sequential B1 RGB retained.
budget_and_Dev.extension: After every required Dev row through a stage is complete, extend all six fits by three full Train epochs if any normal mode/cue best HOTA improved by more than0.2 absolute points against its earlier-stage best. At stage6 compare with best through epoch3; at stage9 compare with best through epoch6. Stop by12 regardless. Never extend a subset or use Test to extend.
budget_and_Dev.learning_rate: One pre-fixed12-epoch cosine horizon, not reset when Dev authorizes extension.
budget_and_Dev.primary: Highest complete normal IR Dev HOTA among both modes and all executed epochs; tie higher AssA, then IDF1, then earlier epoch, then quality mode. Freeze before any Test output is read.
budget_and_Dev.controls: Keep each of six normal fits own Dev-best model, even negative. Strong matched RGB/gray controls use the primary mode and their own Dev-best epoch; also report all six individually.

removals.fit_condition: Fit removals only if the normal IR primary exceeds direct RGB, its same-mode RGB control and its same-mode gray control on complete Dev. Otherwise keep the rejected architecture result, still test all six normal formal fits and interventions, and proceed to a new hypothesis.
removals.quality_removal_scope: Disables the feature fusion quality gate. The temporal noise MLP still uses detached quality statistics; do not claim this removes every quality signal.
removals.RGB_protection_scope: Disables the teacher-confidence feature mask and sets reliable RGB preservation weight to0; report as this combined protection mechanism.
removals.selection: Each removal gets complete Dev curves, its own Dev best and a checkpoint paired with the frozen primary epoch. Report both on full Test without promoting a removal using Test.
removals.credit: A positive IR-vs-control effect and positive matched removal deltas on complete Dev and Test are necessary. Code/tests/loss changes do not count as contributions.

formal_Test.numeric_conventions: Both new modes emit sequential B1 outputs. Preserve and disclose B1-vs-canonical-B4 numerical differences, never claim exact parity between batch sizes. Zero/missing fusion must exactly match freshly encoded B1 RGB across all frames, tracks, all39 summary fields and entire official detailed CSV. Verify source weights, preprocessing, NMS, detector/tracker settings before accuracy.
formal_Test.extra_fairness: Also require at least+5 points over fresh B1 RGB if that baseline is higher; do not change the fixed canonical target downward.
formal_Test.reporting: All official summary fields, complete detailed CSV, per-sequence results, detections/track provenance and measured end-to-end latency/memory. Cached replay FPS is not end-to-end FPS.

GPU_execution.release: Wait for all existing structural full-Train fits/50Dev/runtime/Test/exports and legacy9 structural backfill to finish, and confirm their GPU workers have exited. Do not interrupt other users or existing healthy jobs.
GPU_execution.formal_launch_requires: Actual two-clip GPU canary on both modes and matched cues, source/zero/off detector identity, source-pinned launch registry, fully implemented Dev/selection/Test/export pipeline. CPU engineering alone cannot release formal fitting.

engineering_canary.registered_Train_prefix: First two clips of the actual epoch1 schedule; eight consecutive Train frames, no Dev/Test labels/metrics.
engineering_canary.modes_and_cues: All six matched normal fits, same seed0 initialization by mode. Continue detached temporal memory across the two optimizer updates.
engineering_canary.output: Only JSON diagnostics and source proofs. No saved model, new images or feature bank; not formal training/convergence or innovation evidence.

storage.checkpoints: Compact auxiliary-only snapshots and resumable latest; never duplicate the198MB frozen RGB model. No weights/raw outputs/images/features in Git.

limitations: Previously exposed historical Test is exploratory, not a new blind evaluation.
Original RGB pretraining saw current Dev videos.
The scalar pseudo-IR is generated from RGB and adds no physical thermal sensor information.
All named primitives have prior art; architecture contribution and gain remain hypotheses.
